text$="outer":PROCouter:PRINT text$
value=1.5:whole%=-7:byte&=255:s$="old":PROCtypes(2.5,9.9,257,"new"):PRINT ;value;":";whole%;":";byte&;":";s$
copy$="original":PROCslice(copy$):PRINT copy$
PROCrecursive(4):PRINT ;n%
END
DEF PROCouter:LOCAL text$:text$="inner":PROCsee:ENDPROC
DEF PROCsee:PRINT text$:ENDPROC
DEF PROCtypes(value,whole%,byte&,s$):PRINT ;value;":";whole%;":";byte&;":";s$:ENDPROC
DEF PROCslice(s$):MID$(s$,2,2)="XY":PRINT s$:ENDPROC
DEF PROCrecursive(n%):PRINT ;n%:IF n%>0 THEN PROCrecursive(n%-1)
ENDPROC

PRINT LEFT$(FNletters);":";LEFT$(FNletters,2);":";RIGHT$(FNletters,2)
PRINT MID$(FNletters,2);":";MID$(FNletters,0);":";MID$(FNletters,2,3)
PRINT ;LEN FNletters;":";ASC FNletters;":";VAL FNdigits;":";INSTR(FNletters,FNneedle)
PRINT ;INSTR(FNletters,FNneedle,FNcount);":";(FNletters="ABCDEF");":";("ABCDEF"=FNletters)
PRINT ;ASC LEFT$(FNbytes);":";ASC MID$(FNbytes,0,1);":";ASC RIGHT$(FNbytes,1)
PRINT "["+LEFT$(FNletters)+"]";":";STRING$(2,STR$ FNnumber)
END
DEF FNletters="ABCDEF"
DEF FNneedle="CD"
DEF FNdigits="12.5"
DEF FNcount:scratch$="changed":=2
DEF FNbytes=CHR$(0)+CHR$(128)+CHR$(255)
DEF FNnumber=3
